real_defects.issue: Below the paid-leave size threshold (MD under 15, OR under 10) the balance-cap finding still said 'Your largest balance liability is $15,360' while the table and maxBalanceTotal said n/a / 0 (repro: compute({state:'MD',employees:12,covered:12,hoursPerWeek:40,weeks:52,wage:20})). Fixed: the finding says the balance is protected unpaid time, not a payroll liability; test covers MD, OR, MA, NY.

Oregon had no annual accrual cap, so a 40 h/week employee 'earns about 69.3 hours' though ORS 653.606 lets the employer cap accrual at 40 a year (balance 80; BOLI guidance). Fixed with acc: 40 like MD/MN; page FAQ updated; test added.
parse accepted more employees to cost than the business has (employees 3, covered 50 costed 50 people). Fixed: error when covered > employees; test added.
